summary: Defines the declarative descriptor system: ProfileDescriptor (immutable description of a settings profile), ParameterSpec (one settings field with name, type, tier, default, driver_key, secret, transform, validator, template), and MISSING sentinel. Consumer domains declare a ProfileDescriptor once and hand it to DescriptorProfile via __descriptor__.
extension_points: ProfileDescriptor.metadata — domain-specific bag for extra descriptor data
lifecycle_notes: MISSING is a singleton sentinel — use `is MISSING` not `== MISSING`
ProfileDescriptor is frozen — instantiate once and share across all profile class registrations
ParameterSpec.secret=True wraps the type as SecretStr; unwrapping happens at _default_kwargs()
documentation_hooks: ParameterSpec fields map directly to pydantic FieldInfo — tier and description become schema metadata
driver_key=None means domain adapter handles emission; set driver_key for 1:1 mappings
